audit_items.proof_trace: Two mutually-exclusive guards enforce the invariant: `deposit_ctoken` asserts `!debts.contains(CoinType)` (L86-89) before adding collateral, and `try_borrow_asset` asserts `!is_supporting_collateral<CoinType>()` (L121-124) before adding the first debt entry. No code path can make `is_supporting_collateral` true while a debt entry exists, because `deposit_ctoken` aborts if the debt exists; repeat borrows (the branch without the guard) are unreachable with collateral active for the same reason. Liquidation, flash loans, and withdrawal paths do not create a simultaneous collateral+debt state.
